title: Contracted product presentation under change of coefficients
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\varphi:G\to G'$ be a morphism of abelian sheaves on $S_{\mathrm{Et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and let $T$ and $T'$ be torsors under $G$ and $G'$ respectively [def-sc-gm-torsor]. A contracted product presentation of $T'$ consists of a natural family $q_U:T(U)\times G'(U)\to T'(U)$ invariant under $(t,h)\mapsto(g\cdot t,h-\varphi_U(g))$ and satisfying $q_U(t,h+k)=k\cdot q_U(t,h)$. For every sheaf of sets $F$ and natural invariant family $a_U:T(U)\times G'(U)\to F(U)$ there is a unique morphism of sheaves $l:T'\to F$ with $l_U(q_U(t,h))=a_U(t,h)$. This is the sheaf quotient universal property specifying the sheafification of the orbit presheaf $(T\times G')/G$, with $G'$ acting by translation on the second factor.
